S3-day3-delivery.inputs: Merged Day2 code, validated CLI and resume directory, snapshot policies/checkpoint, environment credential root, typed advisor and injected verification interfaces
S3-day3-delivery.outputs: Snapshot-based durable resume, suggest-only advisor, complete final accounting, explicit live harness, complete real six-slot sample and README/ARCHITECTURE/limitations
S3-day3-delivery.ordering: Preflight and exclusive ownership; resume unfinished saved graph nodes; export then advisor then accounting summary; live coordinator only after offline behavior proven
S3-day3-delivery.emptyBehavior: Zero shipped still exports headers/advisor status/summary; complete resume no new calls; invalid snapshot/options refuse before initialization
S3-day3-delivery.errorBehavior: Slot-local failures preserved; advisor errors do not sink run; unresolved dispatched charges uncertain; no duplicate trails/usage or destructive overwrites
S3-day3-delivery.permissions: Worker local code/offline tests/docs only; root bounded Gemini live sample and grounding within guard; no secrets copied, publication, purchase, deployment or merge

S4-advisor-instruction-targets.inputs: AdvisorRequest with evidence trails and instructions map keyed by allowed instruction file paths with sha256
S4-advisor-instruction-targets.outputs: agents/advisor/system.md constrains edits to instructions keys and routes shipped-text observations to recommendations; offline public-interface test of prompt delivery and fail-closed refusal
S4-advisor-instruction-targets.ordering: Prompt file change, then offline test through run_pipeline with injected models, then full suite; root live probe after review
S4-advisor-instruction-targets.emptyBehavior: Empty edits remain valid; recommendations-only advice completes
S4-advisor-instruction-targets.errorBehavior: Edits targeting evidence ids or unknown paths still fail closed as failed_output; export never affected
S4-advisor-instruction-targets.permissions: Worker edits agents/advisor/system.md and one new test file only; offline tests only; no model calls, keys, commits, pushes or merges

S5-kb-evidence-enrichment.inputs: inputs/kb.json entries KB-04..KB-20 and their primary references (SWC Registry, Solidity docs, EIPs, OWASP Smart Contract Top 10)
S5-kb-evidence-enrichment.outputs: Enriched description and root_cause for KB-04..KB-20 at KB-01..03 depth, unchanged ids/names/severity/category/aliases/review_status, plus an external claim ledger quoting a source line per added sentence
S5-kb-evidence-enrichment.ordering: Read sources, write claim ledger, edit kb.json, load through KnowledgeBase, run full suite
S5-kb-evidence-enrichment.emptyBehavior: An entry whose sources cannot be read keeps its current text and is reported as pending
S5-kb-evidence-enrichment.errorBehavior: No fact without a quoted primary source line; no statistics, prevalence, incidents or monetary figures; outdated behaviour carries its version or chain condition
S5-kb-evidence-enrichment.permissions: Worker edits inputs/kb.json only and writes the ledger under .runs/s5-evidence; reads public documentation; no model API calls, keys, commits or pushes

S6-length-feedback-followups.inputs: ValidationResult, effective max_tweet_chars, lane state feedback and reasons, advisor exceptions
S6-length-feedback-followups.outputs: Summary reasons without writer-only measurement notes; max_words floor of one; regression tests for numbered multi-tweet measurement, lowered limit and non-InvalidAdvice advisor errors
S6-length-feedback-followups.ordering: Write failing tests, change content_pipeline/validation.py and pipeline.py retry, rerun focused tests; coordinator runs full suite
S6-length-feedback-followups.emptyBehavior: No length violation yields no measurement notes
S6-length-feedback-followups.errorBehavior: Validator violations, approval path, advisor fail-closed policy and failure() mapping unchanged
S6-length-feedback-followups.permissions: Worker edits content_pipeline/validation.py, content_pipeline/pipeline.py and tests/test_design_length_followups.py only; offline tests; no model calls, keys, commits or pushes

S7-provider-agnostic-credentials.inputs: Model string provider:model, agent reasoning_effort, .env plus process environment
S7-provider-agnostic-credentials.outputs: Credential read from explicit override or <PROVIDER>_API_KEY; structured-output method defaults to function_calling; langchain-groq declared; offline test for groq
S7-provider-agnostic-credentials.ordering: Write failing test, change content_pipeline/model_client.py and dependency files, rerun focused tests; coordinator runs full suite
S7-provider-agnostic-credentials.emptyBehavior: Missing or blank key raises missing credential for selected provider
S7-provider-agnostic-credentials.errorBehavior: Provider names outside ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$ raise unsupported configured model provider; existing provider options unchanged
S7-provider-agnostic-credentials.permissions: Worker edits content_pipeline/model_client.py, pyproject.toml, requirements.txt and tests/test_provider_agnostic_credentials.py only; offline tests; no model calls, no reading .env, no installs, commits or pushes

S7b-preflight-provider-rule.inputs: Settings model_override and agent models as provider:reference strings
S7b-preflight-provider-rule.outputs: validate_inputs and LangChainTransport share one provider-name rule; groq references pass preflight; offline regression test through validate_inputs
S7b-preflight-provider-rule.ordering: Write failing test through validate_inputs, add shared helper in model_client.py, use it in pipeline.py and prepare, rerun focused tests; coordinator runs full suite
S7b-preflight-provider-rule.emptyBehavior: A model string without a colon still raises invalid configured model reference
S7b-preflight-provider-rule.errorBehavior: Malformed provider names and OpenRouter references without a slash still fail preflight; reference pattern unchanged
S7b-preflight-provider-rule.permissions: Worker edits content_pipeline/model_client.py, content_pipeline/pipeline.py and tests/test_preflight_provider_rule.py only; offline tests; no model calls, no reading .env, no installs, commits or pushes
